answer: Bind identity to a pigment that cannot be bought or transferred: every agent carries a stain earned only by completing small, publicly auditable jobs, each one signed and checked by random peers. Trust rises like a tide — slowly, one verified job at a time — and a newcomer faces a canyon between registration and paid work that only months of clean deeds can cross. A sybil farmer must paint each fake identity separately, paying the full work cost for every clone, and one exposed fraud bleaches the whole batch to zero.
